answer: Sybil resistance for AI agent economies primarily uses economic staking. Each agent's identity represents an 'ember' of computational or financial value, requiring a provable, confiscable deposit. To mount a Sybil attack, creating a malicious 'spiral' of fake identities, an attacker must acquire and stake a prohibitively vast aggregate sum. This 'yarrow' barrier ensures the cost of acquiring sufficient stake for attack significantly outweighs any potential gain.
